title: POST /api/projects/:id/milestones/:mid/complete — complete milestone and award points
description: Mark a milestone as completed, award 50 points, log a milestone_completed timeline event, and update the project level if a threshold is crossed.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Returns 400 if milestone is already completed
Sets milestone status = completed, completed_at = NOW()
Awards +50 points to the project and logs in points_log
Logs a milestone_completed timeline event with milestone name
Updates project level if points cross a threshold

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find milestone, verify it belongs to project and is not already completed (return 400 if so). 3) Update milestone: status='completed', completed_at=NOW(). 4) Call awardPoints(projectId, 50, 'Milestone completed: NAME', 'milestone'). 5) Call logTimelineEvent(projectId, 'milestone_completed', { milestoneId: mid, milestoneName: name, points: 50 }). 6) Fetch updated project. 7) Return 200 with { milestone, project }.
Create and complete a milestone — verify status=completed, points_total increased by 50, timeline event created. Try completing again — expect 400.
